system.description:
You move with purpose and your weapon follows a predestined path. Select up to 3 spaces you can see within range. You move into one of the chosen spaces and strike at a creature within your weapons range at that space leaving ripples in the air and surrounding gasses as your weapon ignites upon impact. Make one melee taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 7d6. Repeat this for each of the chosen spaces, once.

If you score a hit with at least one of these attacks, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Burned on a failure.

Chain 2. Select one additional space to move to, attacking a creature within your weapons range.

Chain 3. If you score a critical hit, you regain the chakra cost of this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
